# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at high effort, 2.8× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 58.6 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.2× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.7 %, cost 194× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 574 sources · 1927 benchmarks · 8509 measurements. Updated 2026-10-21. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.5× to 2.8× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 1.2 to 4.1 points lower on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.6 %, cost 293×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.8 %, cost 35×): 8.3× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.6 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 2.6× to 6.5× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 2.1 points lower and 6.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.6 %, cost 293×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (70.9 %, cost 33×): 8.9× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.8 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.6 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 25× to 70× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 6.5 to 13.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.6 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.2 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.2 %, cost 12×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (64.8 %, cost 70×): 6.0× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.7× to 2.8× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.9 to 9.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 72.8 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.8 %, cost 115×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is high (72.2 %, cost 43×): 2.6× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 17× to 25× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 10.5 to 15.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.2 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.2 %, cost 12×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (66.0 %, cost 25×): 2.1× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 7.7× to 12× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 6.2 to 9.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.8 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 64.2 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (64.2 %, cost 12×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (66.9 %, cost 18×): 1.6× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.9× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 2.3 to 4.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.6 %): Fable 5's best is max at 67.8 %. To match Fable 5 at max (67.8 %, cost 270×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is medium (67.2 %, cost 84×): 3.2× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.3× what Opus 5 costs and scores 3.5 to 5.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Opus 5's best is max at 69.6 %. To match Opus 5 at max (69.6 %, cost 148×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.8 %, cost 35×): 4.2× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.6× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 8.9 to 13.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.8 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 60.1 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (60.1 %, cost 109×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (61.7 %, cost 13×): 8.5× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
